## Hygiene & Evidence Checklist
- [ ] Zero proprietary game binaries (`.exe`, `.dll`), saves (`.v2`), Wine prefixes, or raw memory dumps are included.
- [ ] No personal local paths (`/home/<user>/...`, `/Users/<user>/...`) are hardcoded.
- [ ] Python scripts pass `python3 -m py_compile`.
- [ ] Claims in docs/contracts distinguish `[confirmed]` vs `[inferred]` and cite exact addresses/commands.
